description: This PHP source file defines the ClaimAttachmentAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing claim attachments within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, viewing, updating, and deleting claim attachments, using OpenApi annotations for documentation and implementing CRUD operations with transaction management. The class interacts with data models, services, and traits related to claim attachments and leverages API validation rules and response formatting.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentAPI
classes.description: This class manages API endpoints related to claim attachments, supporting operations like listing, creating, viewing, updating, and deleting claim attachments through REST API calls, with comprehensive validation, transaction management, and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of claim attachments associated with a specific request, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new claim attachment for a specified request, handling attachment data, validation, and transaction control.

methods.name: setAttachment
methods.description: Sets attachment details from request parameters into a ClaimAttachment entity.

methods.name: getPartialClaimAttachment
methods.description: Returns a partial view of a claim attachment, suitable for API responses.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified attachments from a claim request after validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing claim attachments, including pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific claim attachment.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single claim attachment.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing claim attachment with new data, supporting partial updates and validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating claim attachments.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating new claim attachments.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting claim attachments.
